wilfred/tests/test_foundry_e2e.py.name: Agent Foundry end-to-end tests
wilfred/tests/test_foundry_e2e.py.description: Walks the whole Agent Foundry process from idea to finished agent, and proves forged or tampered projects and unlicensed parts are rejected.

wilfred/tests/test_foundry_execution.py.name: Agent running tests
wilfred/tests/test_foundry_execution.py.description: Proves a built agent really runs its test scenarios in isolation and that wrong or contradictory answers are caught.

wilfred/tests/test_foundry_isolation.py.name: Agent sandbox tests
wilfred/tests/test_foundry_isolation.py.description: Proves, using the real Mac security rules, that a generated agent cannot read owner files, reach the internet or start other programs.

wilfred/tests/test_foundry_recovery.py.name: Agent crash recovery tests
wilfred/tests/test_foundry_recovery.py.description: Kills the process mid-save and proves the project continues afterwards with earlier versions intact.

wilfred/tests/test_gate_authority.py.name: Check authority tests
wilfred/tests/test_gate_authority.py.description: Proves an automatic check cannot pretend to be a human approval or another kind of sign-off.

wilfred/tests/test_gate_registry.py.name: Per-language check tests
wilfred/tests/test_gate_registry.py.description: Checks the right automatic checks are chosen for each kind of project, and that failing or missing build and test steps are handled correctly.

wilfred/tests/test_gates.py.name: Approval gate tests
wilfred/tests/test_gates.py.description: Proves risky actions stop until a person signs, that a bare marker file is not approval, and that a rejected run stays stopped.

wilfred/tests/test_generated_artifacts.p.name: Generated file exemption tests
wilfred/tests/test_generated_artifacts.p.description: Checks files that are regenerated by a command may be fully rewritten when declared, while ordinary source files keep their protection.

wilfred/tests/test_generated_hardening.p.name: Generated file strictness tests
wilfred/tests/test_generated_hardening.p.description: Proves the generated-file exemption cannot be abused with broad patterns, executable settings or commands that do not truly reproduce the file.

wilfred/tests/test_guardrails.py.name: Scope guardrail tests
wilfred/tests/test_guardrails.py.description: Proves a change outside its allowed area is rejected and undone cleanly, and that whole-file rewrites are blocked.

wilfred/tests/test_human_approvals_polic.name: Owner approval switch tests
wilfred/tests/test_human_approvals_polic.description: Checks the owner's switch for auto-approving some overrides: honest labels, no effect when removed, and failed checks or low scores never waived.

wilfred/tests/test_import_guard.py.name: Forbidden dependency tests
wilfred/tests/test_import_guard.py.description: Proves the engine never pulls in the old Linear code or any AI service, so it stays predictable and free of model calls.

wilfred/tests/test_improve.py.name: Improve mode tests
wilfred/tests/test_improve.py.description: Checks improving existing code keeps all earlier tests alive: deleted, skipped, weakened or broken tests block the change.

wilfred/tests/test_installation.py.name: Install package test
wilfred/tests/test_installation.py.description: Proves the installable package is self-contained and gives both Wilfred commands once installed.

wilfred/tests/test_installed_hook_e2e.py.name: Installed safety hook tests
wilfred/tests/test_installed_hook_e2e.py.description: Proves the installed write-blocking hook really stops out-of-scope and forbidden writes before any file is created.

wilfred/tests/test_known_failures.py.name: Known failure exemption tests
wilfred/tests/test_known_failures.py.description: Checks a human-declared, committed list of tests that only fail on this computer is honoured, and that new or hidden failures are never excused.

wilfred/tests/test_learning_evidence.py.name: Lesson evidence tests
wilfred/tests/test_learning_evidence.py.description: Checks each proposed lesson states how strong its evidence is, flags single-run signals and measures whether a fix really reduced problems.

wilfred/tests/test_learning.py.name: Learning loop tests
wilfred/tests/test_learning.py.description: Proves Wilfred proposes improvements from past runs but never starts one without a signed human approval.

wilfred/tests/test_lessons.py.name: Pilot lessons tests
wilfred/tests/test_lessons.py.description: Checks the lessons from the pilot are saved and handed to future runs when relevant.

wilfred/tests/test_observability.py.name: Run monitoring tests
wilfred/tests/test_observability.py.description: Checks problem patterns across runs are detected from saved records, shown on a dashboard and sent to a human without repeating alerts.

wilfred/tests/test_plan_lint.py.name: Plan quality check tests
wilfred/tests/test_plan_lint.py.description: Checks plans are cut by responsibility, flags rules split from where they are shown, and blocks high-risk plans.

wilfred/tests/test_pretooluse_hook.py.name: Write-time block tests
wilfred/tests/test_pretooluse_hook.py.description: Proves the hook that runs before each edit allows in-scope writes, denies the rest, and denies safely when its own rules are unreadable.

wilfred/tests/test_protected_paths.py.name: Sensitive file detection tests
wilfred/tests/test_protected_paths.py.description: Checks files holding keys, environment settings, deployment or CI setup are recognised as sensitive and need a human review.

wilfred/tests/test_quality_committed_pat.name: Review of committed changes tests
wilfred/tests/test_quality_committed_pat.description: Proves quality review covers changes already committed since the run began and stops if the starting point is invalid.

wilfred/tests/test_quality.py.name: Quality loop tests
wilfred/tests/test_quality.py.description: Proves the quality score is the lowest lens not the average, failed checks always block, and unresolved issues go back to the person.

wilfred/tests/test_regression_scope.py.name: Test baseline tests
wilfred/tests/test_regression_scope.py.description: Checks changed tests need exact approval, and that an empty or already-failing starting baseline is refused.

wilfred/tests/test_resume.py.name: Run resume tests
wilfred/tests/test_resume.py.description: Checks an interrupted run restarts at the right step after missing or half-written files, and never revives a failed run.

wilfred/tests/test_review_boundary_e2e.p.name: Independent review boundary test
wilfred/tests/test_review_boundary_e2e.p.description: Proves the independent review works end to end and that no Codex review path exists that could bypass it.

wilfred/tests/test_review_fixes.py.name: Review finding fix tests
wilfred/tests/test_review_fixes.py.description: Locks in fixes for problems an independent review found: unsafe generated-file paths, misread requirements and false leak alerts.

wilfred/tests/test_review_lenses.py.name: Review perspective tests
wilfred/tests/test_review_lenses.py.description: Checks the four standard review perspectives are always used, optional ones only when asked, and drift or truncation warnings appear.

wilfred/tests/test_review_provenance.py.name: Review authorship tests
wilfred/tests/test_review_provenance.py.description: Proves a review the builder wrote about its own work never counts as a pass, and only signed independent reviews do.

wilfred/tests/test_review.py.name: Review mode tests
wilfred/tests/test_review.py.description: Checks review mode can look at a whole repo, chosen paths or a change range without modifying anything, and gives a clear verdict.

wilfred/tests/test_severity_floor.py.name: Minimum severity tests
wilfred/tests/test_severity_floor.py.description: Proves certain serious problem types are always rated at least major, so a high score or mislabelled finding cannot hide them.

wilfred/tests/test_state_claims.py.name: Fresh facts rule tests
wilfred/tests/test_state_claims.py.description: Checks the rule that any claim about current state must be re-verified is written down and built into the review and verify steps.

wilfred/tests/test_traceability.py.name: Requirement tracing tests
wilfred/tests/test_traceability.py.description: Proves every requirement from the shaping notes is either covered, explicitly out of scope, or flagged as missing.

wilfred/tests/test_verify_checks.py.name: Reproducibility and demo tests
wilfred/tests/test_verify_checks.py.description: Checks regenerated files match except for declared changing fields, and that a live demo with blocked or missing evidence is flagged.

wilfred/tests/test_wave_planner.py.name: Parallel work planning tests
wilfred/tests/test_wave_planner.py.description: Proves tasks touching separate files run together, overlapping ones are split, and dependencies and cycles are handled.
